title: What I can build
description: I can build a project from scratch or improve something that already exists: web applications, dashboards, integrations, and automations, through to publication.

sections.delivery: From implementation to a real environment

items.title: Web applications
items.description: I build custom web applications, from interfaces to core workflows, with a structure that stays easy to change as the project grows.

items.title: Dashboards
items.description: I organize data, metrics, and information into easy-to-read dashboards, making what matters visible at a glance and useful for decision-making.

items.title: APIs & integrations
items.description: I connect applications, services, and data sources through APIs and integrations, so different systems can exchange information without manual steps.

items.title: Automation tools
items.description: I automate repetitive tasks and workflows that currently require manual work, saving time and reducing the chance of errors.
